question: What level of subtlety can a thoroughly trained ear discern in musical tones?
premises: Intense and sustained practice can refine the organ of hearing.
Musical tones contain inner microtonal components.
A trained listener can detect even slight deficiency or excess in those microtones.
inference: Deep training enables perception of extremely fine distinctions within a single tonal field.
uncertainties: The technical term śruti is rendered generally as microtone; its precise musical value is context-dependent.
plain_english: One whose ear has been refined by intense, sustained practice can indeed discern even the slight deficiency or excess of the inner microtones within those notes.
